gpu_scope: Whole GPU including background. Per-flight GPU attribution unavailable; baseline subtraction is not causal attribution.

reference_comparison.scope: Historical same-map/mode timing ceiling only; older policy CPU is not a comparison control

strict_recovery_audit.scope: Source metadata and completed log episodes only; not physical safety proof

heading_policy_audit.scope: Source acquisition center policy; aperture and Full recovery unchanged

optimizer_clearance_gate_audit.scope: One-time branch coverage; objective equivalence is tested separately

static_latched_audit.scope: No static timer/poll; retained executor CPU remains in total; separate bound delivery preflight required

static_latched_preflight.scope: No-flight transport and actual RViz reader migration; not flight/CPU/safety certification

command.context_scope: All observed intervals including quantile overflow; epoch metadata is not used for interval arithmetic
command.scope: Observed messages; includes DDS/observer jitter and intentional command holds, not producer callback latency

odometry.context_scope: All observed intervals including quantile overflow; epoch metadata is not used for interval arithmetic
odometry.scope: Observed messages; includes DDS/observer jitter and intentional command holds, not producer callback latency

goal_identity_audit.scope: Explicit creation-ID linkage and exercised coverage; not proof that every repeat may safely be suppressed

headless_parameter_audit.scope: Composed nodes only; remote parameter services/events unavailable under opt-in; external mission node unchanged

small_pool_timing.scope: Finite-run engineering guard; command message gaps include intentional holds and are not callback gaps

small_pool_profile_reference.scope: Matched profiled finite-run timing preflight; not a real-time or safety guarantee
